subject: E4.1 v1-dependency F5: two perl CORE modules still gate to v1 (CPAN::Meta::Requirements::Range, ExtUtils::MM_Unix)
description:
Found by the s342 rule-2 audit (docs/v1-live-share-audit.md, family F5) — invisible to the s341 sweep-only audit because only the CPAN board loads these.

1. `CPAN/Meta/Requirements/Range.pm` — "Parser2 TODO: poisoned condition-my $err (string eval)" (3 events).
   SAME SHAPE as the Math::BigInt blocker cleared in s342b: the cond-my poison test still has at least one false positive. The s342b narrowing taught the test that a `foreach my $NAME` BINDS the name; `$err` in Range.pm is poisoned by some other binding form. Start by finding which uses of $err the poison test counts as "outside all binding constructs" — the narrowing helper is `_foreach_my_constructs` in Pl/Parser2.pm.

2. `ExtUtils/MM_Unix.pm` — "Parser2 TODO: self-referential my-init with a below-assignment tail":
   `my $attrs = join " ", map { qq[$_="$attrs{$_}"] } sort keys %attrs;`
   (the initialiser mentions %attrs, a DIFFERENT variable that merely shares the name stem). 2 events.

Both are perl core modules loaded at runtime, so §5a.2 is not satisfied while they gate. Same "every hit is pre-work" rule as Exporter.pm/Math::BigInt.
activeForm: Clearing the two core-module v1 gates
